headline: Human Affairs Committee heard presentation from Revive Recovery Resource Center on recovery housing and support services.
summary: Revive Recovery Resource Center Executive Director Jessica Carter presented to the committee on recovery housing and the organization's services in the Nashua area. No new business, resolutions, or ordinances were taken up, and the committee adjourned after the presentation and public comment.

II.
